description: Pakistan - Biomass Feedstock Crop Yield is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Agriculture, Bioenergy", published or maintained by Oliver James Knight (World Bank Group). Crop residue information aggregated from the Biomass Atlas project field survey raw data. Min minimum crop residue yield; based on minimum crop yield recorded in the field survey, and the minimum Residue To Crop Ratio in the background data (see: industrial\Powerplantmodel.xlsx in this dataset, sheet RCR) Max maximum crop residue yield; based on maximum crop ... Coverage: Pakistan. It has 1 file in HTML. The portal files it under Agriculture, Bioenergy. The portal gives 2016 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
